text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I've got to make this a race that leads 
to the next...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "I am going to win—!! Hyaaaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――In 1st place, Curren Bouquetd'or! She 
has proven her undeniable talent!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
As expected, she's always so consistent! 
Curren Bouquetd'or, that is!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'll run the Japan Cup?! 
Man, I've gotta see the moment she grabs 
victory! I definitely need to keep my 
schedule open—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(My legs are light. Even my heart—feels 
like it's dancing.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I'm getting closer to the place I'm meant 
to reach. I'm certain of it—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Out on the turf, I could really 
feel everyone's passionate expectations—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I know I can shine in the Japan Cup. If 
only I can weave harmony together with 
Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it became a battle where one could 
truly feel that.
choice_data_list: Yeah! ...The Japan Cup is finally next.

Yeah! ...Next up is finally the Japan Cup, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. On that grand stage—I will seize the 
golden flower.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And without fail, I will grasp the golden 
bouquet—!
choice_data_list:
I'll be the brilliance that shows the 
world you exist!

I want a brilliance that proves your 
existence to the world!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—With these very hands, I will unite 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the All Comers concluded on a 
grand, happy note.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, this year's Japan Cup is packed with 
nothing but main-character material!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about it makes me shiver. 
Especially when it comes to... Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is a Kikuka Sho Umamusume with the 
soul of a passionate creator. Her 
breathtaking race tactics constantly amaze 
and captivate countless fans—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is also one of the Umamusume who 
declared her entry for this year's Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Especially right now—she is the most 
talked-about Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If she achieves 8 Turf GⅠ victories at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), then next time, 
expectations will surely rise to 9. The 
spotlight will only continue to grow.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
... Kiseki-san and Tact-san are also 
figures at the center of this era.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“However, even for the two of you, Ai-san 
is…… a very, very high wall, isn't she?”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. ...Ai-chan has always been the 
steadfast protagonist. That's just the 
kind of role she was written for.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes. But that is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I also hope that someday... I can surpass 
Ai-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It will surely become a glorious 
achievement. One that shines brightly upon 
my homeland.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"If I face them with this strength 
nurtured alongside nature, victory 
shouldn't just be a dream. This is surely 
the turning point...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Haha! Love it, Tact-chan! I can really 
feel your burning passion...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—After everything that was said, I made 
up my mind at the Japan Cup the year 
before last, too.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That day, when a 1st place victory was 
clinched right before my eyes with a world 
record.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter what it takes, I'm going to 
surpass "Almond Eye"...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm getting fired up now! This is no 
time to be eating leisurely!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Off to training I go~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah—me too! Um, thank you for the 
meal...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—A brilliance I couldn't help but 
pursue.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(That is the pinnacle, "Almond 
Eye"――indeed.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*――!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —*Haa*, *fuu*...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today, just a little bit farther— with all 
my might...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Heading into the next race, the Japan 
Cup, the final spurt toward the summit 
begins—!"
